answer: Trace-Grove Attestation: each agent joins by submitting a hardware-attested execution trace that forges a unique solution to a rotating sonnet-completion challenge; hashes are indexed in a shared grove. The grove links identities to trace lineage and pays reputation only to unique lineages. Cloning requires separate enclave attestations, fresh compute per clone, and independent histories; trace overlap zeroes rewards. Thus honest agents pay one trace, while sybils bear hardware, compute, and lost-reputation costs exceeding copied identity gains.
